# rzmq

> R Bindings for ‘ZeroMQ’

[![Project Status: Active – The project has reached a stable, usable
state and is being actively
developed.](http://www.repostatus.org/badges/latest/active.svg)](http://www.repostatus.org/#active)
[![Package-License](http://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3-brightgreen.svg?style=flat)](http://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.md)
[![CRAN](http://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/rzmq)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=rzmq)
[![Downloads](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/rzmq?color=brightgreen)](http://www.r-pkg.org/pkg/rzmq)

Interface to the ‘ZeroMQ’ lightweight messaging kernel (see
<http://www.zeromq.org/> for more information).

## Features

rzmq is a message queue for serialized R objects. \* rzmq implements
most the standard socket pairs that ZMQ offers. \* ZMQ devices are not
implemented yet, nor is zmq_poll. \* Look for more features shortly.

## Installation

Binary packages for **OS-X** or **Windows** can be installed directly
from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("rzmq")
```

## Build from source

Installation from source requires
[`ZeroMQ`](http://zeromq.org/area:download). On **Debian** or **Ubuntu**
use [libzmq3-dev](https://packages.debian.org/testing/libzmq3-dev):

    sudo apt-get install -y libzmq3-dev

On **Fedora** we need
[zeromq-devel](https://apps.fedoraproject.org/packages/zeromq-devel):

    sudo yum install zeromq-devel

On **CentOS / RHEL** we install
[zeromq3-devel](https://apps.fedoraproject.org/packages/zeromq3-devel)
via EPEL:

    sudo yum install epel-release
    sudo yum install zeromq3-devel

On **OS-X** use
[zeromq](https://github.com/Homebrew/homebrew-core/blob/master/Formula/zeromq.rb)
from Homebrew:

    brew install zeromq

## Usage

A minimal example of remote execution.

execute this R script on the remote server:

``` r

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
library(rzmq)
context = init.context()
socket = init.socket(context,"ZMQ_REP")
bind.socket(socket,"tcp://*:5555")
while(1) {
    msg = receive.socket(socket);
    fun <- msg$fun
    args <- msg$args
    print(args)
    ans <- do.call(fun,args)
    send.socket(socket,ans);
}
```

and execute this bit locally:

``` r

library(rzmq)

remote.exec <- function(socket,fun,...) {
    send.socket(socket,data=list(fun=fun,args=list(...)))
    receive.socket(socket)
}

substitute(expr)
context = init.context()
socket = init.socket(context,"ZMQ_REQ")
connect.socket(socket,"tcp://localhost:5555")

ans <- remote.exec(socket,sqrt,10000)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bind.socket()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/bind.socket.md)
  : Create an endpoint for accepting connections and bind it to the
  socket referenced by the socket argument.
- [`connect.socket()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/connect.socket.md)
  [`disconnect.socket()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/connect.socket.md)
  : Connect the socket referenced by the socket argument to the endpoint
  specified by the endpoint argument.
- [`init.context()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/init.context.md)
  [`init.socket()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/init.context.md)
  : initailize zmq context and zmq socket
- [`init.message()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/init.message.md)
  : create a message object.
- [`poll.socket()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/poll.socket.md)
  : Polls a list of sockets, waiting for the presence of a nonblocking
  read, write, or error event.
- [`receive.multipart()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/receive.multipart.md)
  : Receive multipart ZMQ message
- [`receive.socket()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/receive.socket.md)
  [`receive.null.msg()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/receive.socket.md)
  [`receive.string()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/receive.socket.md)
  [`receive.int()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/receive.socket.md)
  [`receive.double()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/receive.socket.md)
  : Receive a message from the socket referenced by the socket argument.
- [`send.multipart()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/send.multipart.md)
  : Send multipart ZMQ message.
- [`send.socket()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/send.socket.md)
  [`send.null.msg()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/send.socket.md)
  [`send.raw.string()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/send.socket.md)
  : send a message.
- [`set.hwm()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.swap()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.affinity()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.identity()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`subscribe()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`unsubscribe()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.rate()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.recovery.ivl()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.recovery.ivl.msec()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.mcast.loop()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.sndbuf()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.rcvbuf()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.linger()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.reconnect.ivl()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.zmq.backlog()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.reconnect.ivl.max()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`get.rcvmore()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`get.last.endpoint()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`get.send.timeout()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.send.timeout()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`get.rcv.timeout()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  [`set.rcv.timeout()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/socket.options.md)
  : set a socket option.
- [`zmq.errno()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/zmq.error.md)
  [`zmq.strerror()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/zmq.error.md)
  : get libzmq error numbers and error strings
- [`zmq.version()`](https://docs.ropensci.org/rzmq/reference/zmq.version.md)
  : get version of libzmq
